content.short: A decentralized, AI-powered search engine designed to revolutionize discovery and data accessibility in Web3.
content.description:
Adot is a decentralized, AI-powered search engine built to revolutionize data discovery and accessibility within the Web3 ecosystem. By combining on-chain and off-chain data, Adot provides high-quality insights and advanced natural language processing tailored for blockchain users. It serves as an adaptive platform where developers can build custom mini search engines using their own data sources.

The platform uses pattern recognition to enhance content discovery and investment research. With robust developer APIs, Adot enables the seamless integration of decentralized search functionality into third-party applications and dapps.
